messages:
elaine.pm: Quick sync — finalizing GA criteria for Optimize. Need decisions on SLA targets, docs (runbooks + quickstarts), support model, monitoring/alerts, pricing/billing readiness. Goal: GA in ~2 weeks. Can folks confirm major blockers?

matt.eng: Can we target p95 < 200ms and overall error rate < 0.5% for hosted? For Dedicated/custom contracts we should promise p99 < 500ms and a custom SLA baseline.

sanjay.ml: Those numbers are reasonable as long as we include sequence-length and batch-profile caveats. Recommend adding a stability gate: "meet targets for 72h under expected qps + steady cache behavior".

kyle.infra: Monitoring checklist (high level): token/sec, p95 latency, p99 latency, error rate, queue depth, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate. Alerts: p99 breach, error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, queue depth > 100. I'll wire dashboards and runbooks.

amanda.cs: Support readiness: need written playbooks for common incidents, CS training session(s), and an escalation matrix (L1 -> L2 -> SRE). Define response SLAs (business hours vs enterprise 24/7). We also need sample troubleshooting FAQs for customers.

maria.finance: Pricing/billing checklist: metering end-to-end (tokens and embeddings), billable events validated in staging, pricing page + calculator, internal pricing approval. Also gate: at least one pilot customer on invoice billing verified.

elaine.pm: Proposed GA gates (suggested):
- Docs: quickstart, API reference, runbook + troubleshooting, and a short "what's changed" for customers.
- Metrics: meet SLA targets (above) for 14 continuous days OR 72h + 2 business-critical pilot validations, plus successful canary at 10% traffic.
- Support: playbook + CS training + oncall rotation documented.
- Pricing: billing flow validated + public pricing and calculator.
- Customers: 2 paying customers OR 4 active pilots with positive ops feedback.
Agree or call out additions?

matt.eng: :thumbsup: Add an automated E2E smoke that runs in CI nightly: simulate cold cache + burst load and fail the rollout if it regresses. Also include a rollback runbook snippet in the docs.

deploy-bot: canary started: optimize-v1 -> infra/optimize-canary (10% traffic) :rocket:

kyle.infra: I'll own dashboards and alert thresholds. Action: create Grafana dashboard + pager rules and link them in the GA checklist doc. ETA 3 days.

amanda.cs: I'll produce the support playbook and schedule two training sessions with CS and SE teams. Draft will be in the checklist doc. ETA 5 days.

sanjay.ml: I'll run extended perf + stability runs (72h) against representative workloads (mixed seq lengths). Will post results and regression diffs. ETA 4 days.

maria.finance: I'll validate billing flows in staging and run an invoice test with pilot X. Need list of pilot accounts and contact for invoicing. ETA 2 days.

elaine.pm: Thanks — I'll capture owners in the GA checklist: <https://redwood.atlassian.com/optimize/ga-checklist|GA checklist>. Reconvene Fri 10am to approve final go/no-go. If anyone sees a blocker before then, drop it here or DM. :eyes: :rocket:
